newsitem.title: POLAND: Optimus could start live trade in Feb.
newsitem.headline: Optimus could start live trade in Feb.

text.p: Polish computer maker Optimus SA could start trade in the Warsaw bourse's continuous trade system in February, PAP news agency quoted the bourse's president as saying on Friday.
"It can't be ruled out that Optimus will be traded in the continuous system starting in February," PAP quoted Wieslaw Rozlucki as saying.
PAP said Optimus's possible joining the 21 stocks in the continuous trade system would likely be caused by the stock's entry to the bourse's blue-chip WIG-20 index on January 16.
